content.value: Design a 1st order low pass passive filter using a single resistor $( \mathrm { R } _ { 1 } = 1 . 2 \mathrm { k } \Omega )$ and capacitor $\mathrm { C } _ { 1 } = 0 . 0 2 \mu \mathrm { F } )$ .
